hunt.name: Post-Intrusion LotL and Extortion Chain
hunt.description: This hunt tracks the internal progression of a stealthy intrusion from its initial beachhead to final impact. It begins by identifying living-off-the-land (LotL) binary execution and credential store access on high-value server assets. The flow then pivots to identify data staging activities, such as mass compression in temporary folders, and correlates these with ransomware-related detection findings. Two agent stages evaluate the early beachhead and follow-on extortion behaviors to distinguish coordinated attacks from isolated administrative noise.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, package_name, package_version FROM hb_software_inventory WHERE LOWER(package_name) LIKE '%sql%' OR LOWER(package_name) LIKE '%iis%' OR LOWER(package_name) LIKE '%apache%' OR LOWER(package_name) LIKE '%nginx%' GROUP BY device_hostname, package_name
config.description: Focus the hunt on servers hosting database and web services that are primary targets for extortion.
config.expected_signal: A list of hosts running sensitive server software. Silence means no such software is indexed in the inventory.

primitive_config.label: Identify high-value server targets

primitive_config.expected: A list of hosts running sensitive server software. Silence means no such software is indexed in the inventory.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, process_name, process_cmd_line, user_name, COUNT(DISTINCT device_hostname) AS hosts, MIN(time) AS first_seen FROM hb_process_activity WHERE (instr(',' || '{{lotl_binaries}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(process_name) || ',') > 0 OR instr(',' || '{{lotl_binaries}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(process_original_file_name) || ',') > 0) AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY process_cmd_line HAVING hosts <= 3 ORDER BY hosts ASC
config.description: Find administrative tools running with rare command lines, identifying potential AI-assisted scripting.
config.expected_signal: Rare command lines using built-in tools like powershell or certutil. Silence on a busy host is a strong negative signal.

primitive_config.label: Rare living-off-the-land execution
